---
name: Multimodal publishing expectations
description: The user's intended real outputs for the Multimodal Ingest Studio.
---

The Multimodal Ingest Studio is intended to turn uploaded text/Markdown, PDFs, images, or audio transcripts into a complete eBook and expressive studio TTS audio, assign the category, and launch publisher/reader email campaigns.

**Why:** The user explicitly asked to test this advertised workflow and make it work, rather than leave it as a demonstration.

**How to apply:** Distinguish real generated files, playable narration, and provider-confirmed campaign states from previews and simulations. Do not describe metadata, sample chapters, timer-driven players, or in-app dispatch logs as completed publishing or delivery.
